behavioralConstraints: only direct files ending in .task.json are discovered
unsupported major task schema versions are rejected without fallback
same-major schema versions require explicit reader support
local task schema identity/version must match the reader's explicit ipt.task@1.0.0 support
any malformed invalid or duplicate discovered task prevents a successful registry result
filesystem enumeration or presented path order cannot change normalized registry output
task array field order is preserved as authored
invariants: local repository task schema is authoritative
reader support does not advance automatically when the local schema version changes
no remote schema or network lookup occurs
dependency eligibility and lifecycle state are not interpreted
examples: reverse file presentation still yields identical task-id-sorted registry entries
duplicate valid task IDs fail with TASK_ID_DUPLICATE
edgeCases: empty canonical directory returns an empty registry
malformed JSON reports its source path

expectations: every returned entry is valid under the supported task schema
duplicate task IDs cannot reach the consumer
registry keys equal record taskId values
dependency arrays are preserved exactly as authored
acceptedRanges: zero or more valid task records keyed by unique task ID
failure instead of partial success when any discovered task is invalid
requiredReachableRanges: deterministic invalid or duplicate record rejection
